fountains.source: Example range: Kasco Marine floating fountains, 60 Hz. Pattern height x width, volts, amps and minimum depth as published by the maker (kascomarine.com J Series and VFX Series pages, read 15 Nov 2026). Other makes offer similar sizes. The spray SHAPES drawn on the page are a rendering of each named pattern at the published height and width - check the maker's photos before ordering.
notes: Fountains run on a timer; a bottom air (diffuser) system does the round-the-clock aeration - not drawn.
Each unit needs the minimum water depth listed under it. The ponds are about 4.5 ft below normal this year (owner, 15 Nov 2026): check depth at each spot before ordering.
Power: 1/2 to 1 HP run on 120 V; 2 HP needs 240 V. The overhead line ends at the pole on Pond 1's east bank.
Pond depths are not known yet (asked 15 Nov 2026).

lights.tip: Area light on power pole P1 (existing, the utility's dusk-to-dawn light): about 27 ft up; it comes on by itself at dusk. Size, lamp and direction are typical values, not measured.

marks.c: Red roofs out over the water. Anglers start here.
The biggest tree by the cabin. Its branches spread wider than a house.
Long and green, sitting up on posts.
It has four wheels and hauls the feed.
Rows and rows of bushes. Sweet in June.
Southern grapes growing on a trellis.
Where farm things are kept dry.
Salmon siding and a chimney, up the hill.
A tin roof on posts with no walls.
A giant clump of feathery grass by the shed.
Shiny silver and shaped like a bullet.
A shelter with one side open, far across the farm.
It lights the yard at night, high on a pole.
